description:
Quote the maximum hold for MiniMax relight; nothing is charged.

Required video_url and reference_image_url are owned uploaded media; the image is a lighting sphere.
Source picture duration must be at least 56/24 seconds and at most 15 seconds (up to 100 MB).
Resolutions: 480p, 768p (default), 1080p, 2k; auto aspect maps to adaptive. Original audio is preserved.
Optional prompt is for history only. Pass the returned cost_rub as max_cost_rub when creating.
The hold covers up to 15 output seconds; final usage is settled later, refunding the difference.

prompt.description: History label only; lighting is controlled by reference_image_url.
